headlines.text: Flash back to 2021, when Lance Archer vs. Rey Fenix met in a Qualifying Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.62 ? a good, competitive contest.

Looking back to 2024, when Sammy Guevara reached a milestone worth celebrating: their 100th match in AEW, facing Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Sammy Guevara in a No DQ match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 7.87 ? a well-worked match in a hard-fought men's division clash.
On a Friday in 2023, back when Sammy Guevara vs. Action Andretti headlined Rampage, rated 6.69.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2021, Garrison & Pillman Jr. was no more, reborn as The Varsity Blonds after 1 match, on Dynamite.
Rewind to 2024, when Bryan Danielson vs. Jun Akiyama headlined Collision, rated 7.41 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a hard-fought men's division clash.
On a Friday in 2023, back when The Young Bucks vs. Aussie Open locked horns for the first time, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 7.81 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
